verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is a chat-first AI assistant: users chat with their documents and invoke AI agents with natural-language prompts, and agent skills such as web scraping and search run from those prompts. However, the evidence shows only feature names and taglines. Nothing documents that natural-language commands can operate the product itself, such as managing workspaces, settings or documents. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of product operations beyond chat and agent tasks, in-depth docs on how agent commands are invoked, and hands-on corroboration of agentic command execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
